# Anping Yuanquan Metals Int'l Co., Ltd.

> China-based manufacturer and exporter of steel grating and galvanized steel wire. Founded in 2005, based in Anping County, Hebei — the hometown of wire mesh in China. Export markets cover 50+ countries worldwide.

## Products

- **Steel Grating**: industrial flooring and platform grating for plants, walkways and drainage covers.
- **Galvanized Steel Wire**: hot-dip and electro galvanized wire for construction, fencing and manufacturing.

## Company facts

- Founded: 2005
- Location: No. 229, Chengnan Industrial Park, Anping County, Hebei, China
- Facility: 20,000 m² production area
- Capabilities: CNC cutting, automated welding, hot-dip galvanizing, in-house quality control
- Export markets: 50+ countries worldwide
- Quality: ISO-certified quality management system
